checks.coverage: All 131072 binary input combinations plus eight directed zero-flag transition and wraparound cases

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Unknown or high-impedance input behavior is not specified and was not tested.
No synthesis, timing, or board evidence was produced.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation computes the specified addition or subtraction with truncation to eight bits.
Replaces the faulty bitwise complement condition with an explicit equality-to-zero test.
Assigns result_is_zero on every combinational evaluation to remove inferred storage.
Preserves TopModule and all original port names, widths, and directions; adds no reset, clock, ports, or latency.
static_review: Complete combinational assignments with blocking assignment; eight-bit wraparound and zero detection; no added pipeline or state.
